history.summary: Brand-new (2026 TOP) 28-unit freehold boutique at $3.28M / $2,500 psf for a 1,313 sqft large unit — likely a duplex penthouse given Claydence's stated mix tops out at 3BR/penthouses. Ultra-boutique scale, new-launch top-of-market PSF, and a >$3M quantum make this a weak 5–7yr investment despite the freehold D15 address.
history.rating_rationale: Only 28 units means very thin secondary liquidity, and the $2,500 psf sits right at the new-launch median ($2,501) with explicit new-launch bias — there is no resale discount to capture and exit depends on the next buyer paying a fresh-launch premium for an aging unit. The >$3.28M quantum thins the buyer pool sharply, score_1000 of 401 reflects poor risk-adjusted value, and Eunos MRT is a 840m walk. Freehold D15 is desirable but the entry price already capitalizes it.
red_flags: 28-unit boutique — minimal resale liquidity and amenities
New-launch top PSF ($2,500 vs $2,501 median) with new_launch_bias flag — buying at peak
1,313 sqft 4BR/duplex is niche; Eunos MRT 840m away
catalysts: Freehold tenure in established D15 East Coast lifestyle belt
